name: Veil of the Soulstones
description:
About This Game

Veil of the Soulstones is a brutal, challenging auto battler adventure. Enter the darkness alone or with your fellow Void Hunters, where threats lurk unseen in every shadow. Explore the Void Fields, now engulfed by the endless night, stay vigilant and plan your next steps carefully, or they might be your last.

PREPARE FOR THE HUNT

With a unique combination of elements, Veil of the Soulstones brings a fresh gameplay that rewards curiosity, exploration and coordination, while offering a deep experience that will challenge even the most experienced hunters.

  • Select your Void Hunter: Master each of the 6 playable classes, with unique playstyles, skills and powers.

  • Hunt Solo or in a Group: Recruit your fellow Void Hunters and face the dangers in the dark together, or hunt alone.

  • Uncover Secrets: Find hidden treasures, bosses and dangers as you explore the regions of the world.

  • Loot Powerful Gear: Slay creatures to loot weapons, armor, and jewelry to survive.

  • Item Sets & Builds: Take advantage of powerful item sets to define your Hunter's specialization.

  • Master Synergies: Learn a vast array of skills and traits that interact to create devastating, synergistic chain reactions.

  • Pierce the Veil: Hunt down the source of the Veil and reclaim the lands lost to corruption.
short_desc: Brave the Veil of the Soulstones alone or with your friends in this brutal, real-time auto battler adventure. Loot weapons and armor from every foe to build your strength, and through powerful synergies, slay the creatures that lurk unseen in the shadows.
